fields.description:
h3. What

After browser Back, the row or card that was at the top of the view comes back at the top, fully shown.

h3. Expected

S1-R8: "Horizontal position comes back exactly. Vertically, the row or card that was at the top of the view comes back at the top, fully shown; it may sit up to one row or card from the exact pixel position."

PRD: [Board View & Tech View PRD v55|https://shopview.atlassian.net/wiki/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=845185030] (S1-R8).

h3. Actual (origin/develop, 2026-10-15)

Both views remember the first row or card whose top edge is in view. A row or card that was half visible at the top is skipped, so after Back it sits hidden above the top (seen by Bilal on staging, 14 and 15 Oct). In Tech View the restored row can also land under the held group header.

h3. How to check

* Scroll so a card (Board) or row (Tech View) is half visible at the top, open a work order, press Back: that card or row is at the top, fully shown.
* In Tech View the restored row is not hidden under the held group header.
* Horizontal position is exact.

From the PRD v54/v55 rulings on Bilal's and Slavcho's questions, 2026-10-15.
